station.name: NEW YORK JFK INTL AP, NY US

new-york.notes: Station: JFK, New York City's busiest airport (FAA CY2025 boardings 30,792,806 vs LaGuardia 16,278,532). For comparison, other NYC 1991–2020 normals: USW00014732 NEW YORK LAGUARDIA AP, NY US: 4375.9 HDD65 / 1407.6 CDD65 (flag R, 26 yrs); USW00094728 NEW YORK CNTRL PK TWR, NY US: 4553.3 HDD65 / 1221.5 CDD65 (flag S, 28 yrs) (Central Park, a non-airport station in New York County). The station's coordinates fall in Queens County, NY, about 19.3 km outside New York County, NY (PNNL county polygons). NCEI completeness flag S (standard: 24+ years of qualifying data); 27 years of station data in the 1991–2020 normal. EPA radon zone 3 is from EPA's text-version spreadsheet; the EPA New York state map PDF draws Manhattan with an unlabelled dot pattern rather than a zone colour (the other four boroughs are yellow, Zone 3, on the map and in the spreadsheet). Housing figures are for New York city, New York (Census place 3651000): median year built 1952 (±1); owner share = 1,093,056 owner-occupied / 3,334,088 occupied units.

station.name: WASHINGTON REAGAN AP, VA US

washington-dc.notes: Station is a judgement call: Reagan National (DCA; FAA city Arlington, VA) sits at the District's edge (station 0.4 km from the DC boundary in PNNL's generalized county polygons), but Dulles (IAD; Loudoun County, VA, about 30 km from the DC boundary) had more FAA CY2025 boardings (13,859,569 vs 12,003,594). Dulles is markedly colder: USW00093738 WASHINGTON DC DULLES AP, VA US: 4604.0 HDD65 / 1232.7 CDD65 (flag R, 25 yrs). Swap to Dulles if 'main airport' must mean busiest. NCEI completeness flag S (standard: 24+ years of qualifying data); 25 years of station data in the 1991–2020 normal.
